name: Åbo Akademi University
summary: Swedish-language university in Turku and Vaasa; its bachelor's degrees are taught in Swedish, and English-taught study starts at master's level.

ib.text: Bachelor's applicants must document Swedish: in the IB, Swedish A at grade 2 or Swedish B at grade 5.

notes: All bachelor's degrees at Åbo Akademi are taught in Swedish, and you must document your Swedish to be admitted.
The Danish route needs Dansk A on a Danish upper-secondary degree; for the IB, only Swedish A or B counts.

sources.title: Åbo Akademi — Application guide to the bachelor's level
